nodes.label: Debugger Hotkey Focus Safety
nodes.rationale: handleDebuggerKeyboardShortcut ignores global shortcuts (Space, arrows, R, Esc) when focus is inside input, textarea, select, or contentEditable elements to prevent accidental state resets while typing.

nodes.label: Bidirectional 5-Tuple/4-Tuple Transpiler
nodes.rationale: Automatically splits combined write-and-move steps via auxiliary q_aux states and compiles VTM operational diagrams into canonical 4-tuple transition tables.

nodes.label: Live Alphabet Refactoring
nodes.rationale: Renaming a symbol in the alphabet manager propagates automatically across all transition rules, canvas edges, tables, and tape cells to prevent stale symbol references.

nodes.label: Turing Machine IDE Check Route & QA Roadmap
nodes.norm_label: turing machine ide check route & qa roadmap

nodes.label: Unidirectional Data Flow Architecture
nodes.rationale: Isolates the pure TypeScript computational engine from React and DOM dependencies behind a centralized Zustand hub for deterministic simulation and easier testing.

nodes.label: Sliding-Window Cycle Detection Strategy
nodes.rationale: Continuous execution can freeze the browser on infinite loops; comparing a sliding window of the last 50 configurations avoids expensive full hashing of an infinite sparse tape.

nodes.label: Bi-directional Binding (Canvas <-> Tables/Matrix)
nodes.rationale: Changes on the visual canvas immediately translate to rules5/rules4 structures displayed in TupleTableEditor and MatrixEditor, and table/matrix edits immediately rebuild graph nodes and edges.

nodes.label: Pure Functional Engine Isolation
nodes.rationale: src/engine/ is completely isolated from React, React Flow, Zustand, and DOM APIs; pure functions take immutable state and return new objects without side effects for determinism and headless testing.

nodes.label: SparseTape Infinite Tape Model
nodes.rationale: Tape uses Record<number, string> indexed by integers Z without pre-allocating memory or storing blank symbols; unread cells default to alphabet.blankSymbol via nullish coalescing.

nodes.label: Zero Cyclic Dependencies Invariant
nodes.rationale: Static graph analysis detected 0 import cycles across 301 nodes and 604 edges, confirming clean layered architecture.

nodes.label: Hierarchical Submachines CallStack
nodes.rationale: CallStackFrame stores subMachineId, subMachineName, and returnNodeId so COMPLEX_MACHINE nodes can invoke nested submachines and return on FINISH.

nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph (301 nodes, 604 edges, 12 communities)
nodes.norm_label: graphify knowledge graph (301 nodes, 604 edges, 12 communities)

nodes.label: Atomic Zustand Slice Subscription
nodes.rationale: Components subscribe strictly to needed Zustand state slices to eliminate unnecessary canvas re-renders during tape tick animation or debugger timer updates.

nodes.label: Bounded Undo History (500 Steps)
nodes.rationale: ExecutionSnapshot history is bounded to 500 steps so stepBack debugging works without exhausting browser memory (OOM) during 10,000+ step simulations.

nodes.label: Direct Edge-to-Store Binding
nodes.rationale: CustomTransitionEdge, NodeInspector, and RuleModal call useTuringStore selectors and actions directly so clicking an edge label in React Flow opens the rule editor immediately.

nodes.label: Cascading Atomic Symbol Refactoring (refactorSymbol)
nodes.rationale: refactorSymbol atomically replaces oldSymbol across alphabet, WRITE_SYM nodes, rules5, rules4, edges, initialTape, testCases, and subMachines, then reinitializes runtime to guarantee cross-system consistency.

nodes.label: Immutable Project Updater (updateActiveProject)
nodes.rationale: All active session updates must go through updateActiveProject(updater) to update updatedAt and trigger Zustand selectors reliably.

nodes.label: Zustand Persist with safeStorage Fallback
nodes.rationale: Selectively persists projects, activeProjectId, theme, executionSpeedMs, and keyboardShortcutsEnabled to localStorage with an in-memory Map fallback for SSR or restricted storage environments.

nodes.label: VTM & Validator Extensibility Guide
nodes.rationale: Extending the IDE with new VTM node types or static validation rules follows a decoupled vertical slice across types, pure engine functions, UI registration, and engine.test.ts.

nodes.label: Sugiyama Left-to-Right Auto Layout
nodes.rationale: Uses Dagre Sugiyama layout with rankdir='LR' and animated fitView(300ms) to organize state graphs cleanly from left to right.

nodes.label: Multi-Rule Edge Bundling & Custom Curves
nodes.rationale: Bundles parallel rules into a single edge with interactive badges, renders top-arch self-loops, and computes orthogonal Bezier offsets so bidirectional edges do not overlap.

nodes.label: Vitest Test Framework Migration
nodes.rationale: Migrating from the bare jiti test runner to Vitest provides native Vite toolchain integration and V8 code coverage reporting.
